question.text: Under SEBI SAST Regulations 2011, what is the threshold of voting rights that triggers a mandatory open offer for an Innovators Growth Platform (IGP) listed entity?

explanation.text: The Logic: For a listed entity whose specified securities are listed on the Innovators Growth Platform (IGP), the SAST footnote replaces the standard twenty-five percent threshold with forty-nine percent. So for an IGP-listed entity, the mandatory open-offer trigger is 49% of voting rights instead of the usual 25%. The Trap: 25% is the default threshold for regular listed companies — candidates often default to this number without applying the IGP-specific footnote that lifts the trigger to 49%. Note: Always check whether the target's specified securities are listed on the Innovators Growth Platform before advising on the open-offer trigger — the IGP carve-out materially changes the threshold and the deal structure.
